_README: Code Buddy redaction settings. Copy this file to your project root OR to ~/.config/opencode/, delete the lines you don't need, and restart opencode. All fields are optional. Secrets and South African ID numbers are ALWAYS masked when enabled — the fields below only add to or fine-tune that.
_customWords: YOUR OWN things to always mask — plain text, no regex. Great for project codenames, internal hostnames, or one specific token. Example below masks the word Project-Zeus and the host internal.acme.corp wherever they appear.
_allowlist: Things that LOOK like secrets but must NEVER be masked — e.g. a sample key you show in docs. Example below stops that fake AWS key from being masked.
_disableKinds: Turn OFF categories you don't want. Example: ["CREDIT-CARD", "PHONE"] would stop masking cards and phone numbers. Leave empty [] to keep everything. Valid names: AWS-KEY, GITHUB-TOKEN, STRIPE-KEY, SLACK-TOKEN, GOOGLE-KEY, OPENAI-KEY, JWT, BEARER, PRIVATE-KEY, CONNECTION-STRING, SA-ID, SECRET, EMAIL, SSN, CREDIT-CARD, SA-PHONE, PHONE.
_customPatterns: ADVANCED — your own regular expressions as strings (double the backslashes in JSON). Example: ["\\bINT-\\d{6}\\b"] would mask internal ticket ids like INT-004521. Invalid regexes are ignored.
